paragraphs: Welcome to Tattu, a bold and stylish landing page designed for a modern tattoo studio. This website combines aesthetic minimalism with strong visuals to capture attention and encourage bookings.

Tattu presents the studio’s style, featured works, artist profiles, and contact options in a clear and engaging format. Built with clean and efficient web technologies for fast loading, interactivity, and full responsiveness.
features: 📱 Responsive Design — seamless experience across all screen sizes
🧭 Smooth Navigation — intuitive layout and scrolling between sections
🖼️ Tattoo Gallery — high-quality portfolio of finished works
🧑‍🎨 Artist Highlights — dedicated sections for tattoo artists and their styles
📅 Booking Section — easy access to contact info and reservation requests
